Save this for when you need a financial reset. 📌

359 likes, 6 comments - sasswcass on October 8, 2026: "Can’t afford a house, but somehow the ₹400 matcha makes it into the budget every day. 😭

That’s the Lipstick Effect — when big purchases feel out of reach, we often turn to smaller luxuries that still give us a little happiness.

Matcha, lipstick, skincare, coffee… small treats become the affordable version of “luxury.”

Not necessarily bad spending — just an interesting reflection of how we behave when money feels tight. 👀".

posts.meta_description:
459 likes, 19 comments - sasswcass on October 3, 2026: "Apple Pay is finally in India 🇮🇳🍎

But the interesting part isn’t that you can now tap your iPhone to pay.

It’s why HDFC, ICICI and SBI Card aren’t on board yet.

The fight comes down to one tiny number: 0.15–0.20%.

That sounds tiny… until you realise Indian card economics are already incredibly thin.

So while Apple’s cut may be a small percentage of the transaction, it could eat up a huge chunk of what banks make from that payment.

And that’s why Apple Pay’s India launch is less about technology — and more about who gets paid.

Would you actually switch credit cards just to use Apple Pay? 👀

#ApplePay #ApplePayIndia #CreditCards #PersonalFinance #Fintech".
